infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ForgeFit uses the camera to estimate the nutrition of your meals and to capture progress photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ForgeFit lets you attach progress photos and meal photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ForgeFit can read steps, weight, workouts, sleep and heart rate from Apple Health to keep your dashboard accurate.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: ForgeFit can write completed workouts and body weight to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ForgeFit records your route while an outdoor activity is running. Recording only happens while an activity is running, and you start it yourself.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ForgeFit keeps recording your route when your screen is off or you switch apps mid-run. It never records unless you have started an activity.

plugins.cameraPermission: ForgeFit uses the camera to estimate meal nutrition and capture progress photos.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ForgeFit reads steps, sleep, weight, heart rate and the passive signals your Watch records, so your dashboard reflects what actually happened.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: ForgeFit can write completed workouts and body weight back to Apple Health.
